historical_real_evidence.observed_result: The App displayed the joystick, but the robot did not move and the joystick remained disabled after the control failure.
historical_real_evidence.clock_observation: PHK110 was approximately 707-715 ms behind the Gateway host clock.
historical_real_evidence.root_cause: The client generated intent sent_at from the uncalibrated PHK110 wall clock while the frozen intent TTL remained 200 ms, so the Gateway correctly rejected the intent as expired before any sequence was applied. The control error then left the UI waiting for stop confirmation without consuming the later authoritative stopped snapshot as a safe recovery signal.

fix.trusted_server_time_calibration: Each successfully decoded manual-mapping server frame received over the device-key-pinned WSS updates a server-to-client clock offset. Intent sent_at uses the local UTC clock plus that offset and fails closed until a trusted server_time has been consumed.
fix.stop_confirmed_joystick_recovery: The joystick can leave its local waiting state only when an authoritative session reports stop_confirmed=true with control_state idle or stopped and a replacement control connection exists. Local press, intent timer, velocity, knob and lease state are cleared before recovery.
fix.same_revision_recovery: A same-revision session snapshot is accepted only for the narrow awaiting-stop plus stop-confirmed recovery case; stale lower revisions and terminal-to-nonterminal transitions remain rejected.
